Home Improvement Loans made through Upgrade feature Annual Percentage Rates (APRs) of 0.00%-29.99%. Lowest rates require Autopay. Loans feature repayment terms of 2 years to 15 years. Loans may be disbursed in one or more advances. Actual loan terms may vary depending on, among other things, the exact number of advances, the amount of each advance, the date on which each advance will occur, and if a promotional plan applies. For example, under this promotional plan (i.e., no payments required during the 12 months promotional period beginning after we disburse the first advance, and interest accrues during the promotional period but is waived if the loan is paid in full before the end of the promotional period), if a borrower receives a $10,000 loan with a 10-year term and a 29.49% Annual Percentage Rate (APR), the loan is disbursed in 2 advances (20% on Day 1 and 80% on Day 90), and the loan is not paid in full before the end of the promotional period, the borrower will have a required monthly payment of $279.66 after the promotional period ends. Thick, break-resistant glass provides your family with extra security without sacrificing light or beauty. Energy Bill Savings Reduced Noise Natural Light Easy to Clean Customizable Options Energy Bill Savings Because glass block windows don’t open and no air flows through them, their design prevents drafts and leaks, offering an energy efficient way to save money on your heating and cooling bills. Reduced Noise Champion glass block windows help dampen sound, making them the perfect solution to quieting outside noise. Natural Light Glass blocks windows allow you to brighten your room naturally while eliminating the need for curtains. Easy to Clean Once installed, glass block windows only require simple cleaning – no re-caulking or painting necessary. Customizable Options Glass block windows are available in three glass pattern choices for light and privacy and optional vents and dryer vents provide air flow. Back to Windows Installation From start to finish – Champion takes full responsibility for your install, completing most window installations in a single day. We take care to minimize disruptions, clean up and haul away debris, and leave your home looking better than when we arrived. Plus – our best-in-class Limited Lifetime Warranty † covers every aspect of the installation. What to Expect on Installation Day Step 1 Greeting & Process Our friendly and polite installation experts will greet you at your door, walk through your home with you, and explain the installation process. Step 2 Prepare the Area The installers will put down drop cloths in your home to protect your floors from dirt and debris. Step 3 Prepare and Clean the Opening We will remove your old windows. We will inspect for any damage and repair as needed. Step 4 Insulate and Seal the Frame We will install your new Champion windows, taking extra care to make sure that the window is a perfect fit and performs properly. Installers tightly seal the area around the window and also replace the trim. Step 5 Clean Up We will haul away and dispose of your old windows. We will clean up all work areas and ensure that there is no debris or dirt in the home. Step 6 Verify Our Work Our installers will walk through your home and do a final inspection with you to make sure everything is in perfect order. They will show you how your new windows function, how to clean them, and answer any questions you may have. What to Expect During Your Champion Window Installation Still curious about how the process works? Let our experts walk your through the installation process with this video. Window Installation Video Winter Window Installations Champion is an expert in installing replacement windows year-round, even in the winter. We understand that you don’t want your home exposed to chilly temperatures for prolonged periods of time, so we’re committed to installing your windows quickly and efficiently in the winter. Our Cold Weather Installation Guidelines Minimize Energy Loss If possible, our installers will close off the room they are working in to minimize heat and energy loss as much as possible. Limit Openings Our installers will replace one window at a time to limit the number of openings letting cold air into your home. Eliminate Cold Air Drafts Old to new window swap is done in minutes – eliminating drafts of cold air into your home. Comfort Seal Installing Sealant Champion uses Comfort Seal insulating sealant in all our window installations. This provides a barrier to cold air and keeps your home comfortable and maximizes energy efficiency. We're ready to make your home more beautiful! Schedule Your Free Quote Join our list! Frequently Asked Questions: Why do a home window replacement project? Windows are one of the key elements in how your home looks and feels. Your windows should be aesthetically pleasing and maximize natural daylight as well as airflow inside your home, while also preventing energy loss. High quality replacement windows from Champion can pay for themselves over time in energy bill savings while also increasing your home's overall value. Here are eleven key indicators that your home would benefit from replacement windows are : Your windows are drafty You've noticed an increase in energy bills Your windows just don't work very well Outside noises are seeping in There is often condensation inside your window Your windows are in general disrepair You notice moisture between window panes The frames are decaying The windows make your home look dated An investment in new windows would increase your home's value Your current windows are creating safety and security issues Why should I buy windows directly from the manufacturer? By choosing to buy replacement windows directly from a company like Champion that actually builds them, you avoid working with middlemen and receive factory direct pricing. Additionally, you can be confident you're dealing with an expert in every aspect of your window project . Should you have questions, or need to make a warranty claim in the future, you only have one company to call. When is the best time of the year to replace windows? Window replacements for your home can be done at any time of year. If you know one or more of your windows need replacing , it's best to schedule a free in-home consultation right away to explore your options. You will want to decide on the best types of windows for your space, determine the cost of your windows, and learn how long it will take to get your new windows . It is true that the warmer months are typically busier for window replacement companies as this is the time when more people tend to plan and execute on new home projects. Should I replace all windows in my home at once or just some of them? Consider the following when deciding how many windows in your home to replace: -The overall condition of your current windows. If you're experiencing problems with only a few, it may be more cost-effective to replace only those windows. However, if the majority of your windows are old, drafty, or otherwise in need of replacement, it's often better to do it at once. -The style/appearance of your windows. If you are planning a style change for the look of your home then replacing all of the windows would achieve a cohesive look and improve your home's curb appeal. -The cost of the replacement windows . If you are on a tight budget, replacing just a few windows at a time may be more feasible. However, if you have the financial means to do so or plan to obtain financing then replacing all of the windows at once may be a more cost-effective option in the long run, as it can help to improve the energy efficiency of your home and potentially lower your energy bills. During your free in-home estimate, your Champion rep will walk you through all of your options to help you make the best decision for your home and circumstances.
